title: Site -> Skill v1
objective: Build the first usable Kimi-reference Site -> Skill vertical slice: inspect a live site's semantic/form/network behavior with BrowserCrew's own runtime, normalize evidence, and emit an inspectable candidate executable Skill recipe without copying competitor code or auto-promoting generated behavior.
constraints: functionality first; Kimi 2.0.22 is the proven reference baseline, not the ceiling
independently implement BrowserCrew code; do not copy Kimi source
fresh AX/network/evaluate evidence must remain inspectable and bounded
generated Skills are candidate-only and never auto-promote
preserve BrowserCrew approval semantics and explicit demonstrated/verified boundaries
do not let the externally blocked SK-BROWSER-001 cross-runtime evaluation stop independent Site -> Skill engineering
manual BrowserCrew MVP acceptance remains separately deferred by the user
deliverables: site analyzer/collector using BrowserCrew browser tools
candidate recipe compiler with inferred parameters and provenance
first product/runtime entry point for creating a candidate Skill from a site
next_action: Implement the evidence/recipe contract and collector/compiler first, then wire the smallest product entry point that can create a candidate Site Skill from the current task tab.
